scope: Integrate the divergent remote main without reverting the completed multiplayer UX audit
decisions: Retain shallow Zustand subscriptions in RoomPage, Participants, Playlist and RoomSettingsDialog.
Retain the constant-time queue-head lookup when removing the active item, with next-target cleanup and readiness reset intact.
Keep the shared advanceQueue implementation instead of restoring obsolete duplicated natural-ending logic.
Keep MediaComposer, which already isolates search state; do not add the obsolete PlaylistSearchForm.
Keep the current accessible Close room settings control.
Preserve the verified native YouTube intent, recovery and command acknowledgement implementations.
Preserve the local manifest and exact lockfile; the remote formatting changes must not downgrade audited dependencies.
Consolidate case-colliding palette journal paths into .jules/palette.md while preserving the remote entry.

unit.skipReason: Existing real-Redis cases require Redis; this fresh integration gate ran without cloud services.

coverage: Five independent friends, two independently impaired connections, healthy advancement and recovery
Real YouTube play, native pause, seek, late join, reconnect and degraded continuation
Three same-NAT friends retain separate signed identities through repeated reloads
Permissions, owner handoff, keyboard navigation, desktop and mobile single-composer UI

worktreeVerification.review: Independent read-only review: no remaining critical, important or minor merge defects.

limitations: Fresh server and browser runs used ephemeral local storage with Supabase and Redis disabled and a verification-only JWT secret.
Network emulation and deliberate provider stalls are not measurements of physical packet loss on independent residential networks.
